records.description: 16 Bit designs, trains, and validates machine-learning algorithms to streamline the process of interpreting radiology images. With imaging data banks continually growing and the health system’s increasing reliance on medical-imaging services, radiologists have become a bottleneck in the overall delivery of healthcare. By augmenting medical analysis workflows with artificially intelligent tools, 16 Bit will help […]

4D Surgical is developing an image-guided robotic system that enables precise and efficient neurosurgical access to superficial and deep brain structures. They have developed a novel electromagnetic actuator and robotic technologies that enable neurosurgical robots and neuroimaging with MRI to be used simultaneously for precision guidance during minimally invasive surgeries. Standard neurosurgical procedures rely on […]

A4i is a software company developing a digital therapeutic for schizophrenia and psychosis. The software consists of a clinically-prescribed mobile app and clinical portal that allow clinicians to monitor patients’ condition, and enables patients to manage their own condition. The patient app features a patent-protected, clinically-tested engagement feed, and audio hallucination recognition tool that gives […]

AddGraft Therapeutics cell therapy platform is building stem cell based bio factories capable of producing and deploying any protein directly into a patient’s bloodstream. AddGraft hopes to address some of the major problems with current cell therapies including toxicity, transgene capacity, dose flexibility / control, stable long term expression, and complicated CMC with an ex […]

Alpha Cognition is a drug development company that has developed a compound and identified associated brain receptors that rejuvenate brain cells to address a broad range of mental illnesses and brain-related diseases.

Altis Labs is the computational imaging company accelerating clinical trials with AI. Biopharmaceutical sponsors like AstraZeneca and Bayer rely on Altis’ AI models to run smaller, faster, and more successful clinical trials by quantifying treatment effect earlier. To train its deep learning models, Altis has built the world’s largest real-world cancer imaging database with associated […]

Aperture Bio has developed a single cell proteomics and spatial profiling platform that generates rapid, robust biomarker readouts from minute samples, enabling researchers and drug developers to understand the tumor microenvironment.

Applikate Technologies is a hardware and software company that has developed the first fully automated histology platform with integrated digital imaging. Their patented technology (Clearing Histology with MultiPhoton Microscopy; CHiMP) is a method of staining and imaging whole samples without the need to slice them (i.e., no physical damage). The platform automates the pathology workflow, […]

Ariel Precision Medicine has developed decision-support tools that integrate complex genetics into clinical decision making to enable earlier diagnosis and targeted management for complex chronic digestive and metabolic diseases. By leveraging genetic information, AI, and clinical inputs, Ariel creates a “risk profile” for patients to help clinicians better understand what is driving a patient’s condition, […]

Arma Biosciences is commercializing a first-in-class sensing technology that represents the foundation for a new collection of portable, wearable and implantable monitoring devices. The sensors are versatile and adaptable to the analysis of biomarkers for chronic disease, infectious disease, or personal wellness in biological fluids including blood, saliva, or urine. Requiring no reagents or complex […]

Aufero Medical is a medical device company that produces a catheter stabilizer for a critical procedure called catheter ablation surgery, where radiofrequency energy is used to burn parts of the heart causing arrhythmia.

Augmental is developing the MouthPad^: a smart teeth retainer that enables computer control with tongue, jaw, head, and breath gestures. Using the MouthPad^, people with hand impairment will be able to independently interact with their electronic devices to the same level of expression as an abled-bodied person. Augmental’s vision is to transform human-computer interaction with […]

Axoft is a Brain Computer Interface company developing a brain implant that reliably communicates with neurons over time. Axoft’s novel implant material mimics the soft tissues of the brain, enabling access to long-term, high resolution neural code while minimizing implant drift and long-term damage to brain tissue. Axoft’s vision is to leverage their device to […]

AXONIS Therapeutics is developing first-in-class therapies that enable neurons to resist degeneration, restore excitation/inhibition balance and regenerate, in order to rescue nervous system functions. Their lead drug candidate, an oral KCC2 (CNS-specific chloride transporter) enhancer, acts as a multi-modal neuromodulatory therapy for spinal cord injury, neuropathic pain and other neurological disorders.
Babbly offers software for parents and health-care providers to monitor early speech-based cognitive development of children and provide personalized recommendations to address potential issues.

Bairitone makes a wearable device for sleep that uses AI and Sonar techniques to identify anatomic problems associated with apneas and snoring in the upper airway. Given this information, doctors can make targeted and personalized treatment plans for people with obstructive sleep apnea or snoring.

Biohybrid Solutions is a biotechnology company that grows polymer from the surface of proteins to create a molecular “nanoarmor” around the protein that enhances the stability and tunes protein performance (improved activity; pharmacokinetics) at just one-tenth of the cost.

biotx.ai uses machine-learning techniques to analyze genomic data in combination with various sources of scientific literature to characterize polygenetic biomarkers and inform the development of novel diagnostics and therapies. The company uses open-source data to generate its internal biomarker portfolio as well as the data of pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to help those clients direct […]

BrainSpec is developing software that generates a “virtual brain biopsy” from brain chemistry data collected by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS). Their software uses an AI-powered MRS data processor and the first central database for brain chemistry ever created on a large scale. It enables a fast, non-invasive, and radiation-free biopsy for the diagnosis and treatment […]
Brenus Pharma has developed a platform to generate the next generation of therapeutic cancer vaccines, enabling the immune system to recognize and target tumor cells.
Bridge7 uses AI to scale clinical expertise to improve the efficiency, consistency and quality of delivering cancer care.

Canurta Therapeutics is a biotech company that has developed a proprietary platform that can produce high-purity botanical compounds for neurodegenerative disease treatments, particularly ALS. Current treatments for ALS often target only a single pathway, leaving patients with limited solutions. Canurta’s CNR 401, derived from rare botanical sources like cannflavins, provides a more comprehensive multi-pathway treatment. […]

Capsigen is an adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapy company that engineers viral capsids that can deliver gene payloads to target cells while avoiding other tissues and organs, improving drug efficacy and reducing toxicity. Their platform screens billions of capsid candidates simultaneously and incorporates machine learning and a rational design platform to generate capsids that are […]
Case45 is developing novel pan-cancer precision biomarkers using AI to prognosticate and tailor cancer therapies for patients.
CereCura Nanotherapeutics Inc is a preclinical-stage neuroscience company developing new therapeutics that combine lipid nanoparticles (LNP) and RNA to treat brain disease.

Clarity is building the infrastructure layer for non-invasive brain therapy and intelligence, starting with a prescription, at-home treatment for Alzheimer’s. The platform delivers 40Hz gamma sensory stimulation within cognitively engaging, personalized VR experiences, enabling targeted neuromodulation while continuously capturing structured neural-behavioral data at scale. Early clinical studies demonstrate safety, reliable gamma entrainment, and improvements in […]

Clee Medical is building a real-time intraoperative imaging and AI-driven navigation platform based on Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), enabling direct, continuous visualization of brain tissue during surgery. By overcoming the limitations of static pre-operative imaging, the system adapts to intraoperative changes and provides ultra-high-resolution insight at the point of care. The result is a step-change […]

Cohesys is a medical-device company developing BoneTape, a flexible surgical adhesive to improve the ease and outcome of procedures that currently rely on rigid metal plates and screws. The venture is initially targeting the craniomaxillofacial (facial reconstruction, cranio maxillofacial fixation [CMF]) fracture-surgery market.
Concarlo Therapeutics is developing first-in-class inhibitors of p27, the master regulator of CDK2/4/6, to address drug resitant cancers.

Cordance Medical is developing a non-invasive cap that reversibly opens up the blood-brain barrier (BBB) directly at the site of diseased brain tissue. It can be used for a variety of neurological disorders using a combination of ultrasound and microbubbles. This will enable improved drug delivery for systemic therapies and increase the arsenal of available […]

COSM Medical is a medical-device company that is developing a hardware and software platform to personalize treatments for pelvic floor disorders (PFDs), such as incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse. COSM’s first product is a made-to-measure gynecological prosthetics platform called Gynethotics that improves pessary performance and reduces complications while removing the art of pessary fittings.

Covira Surgical is a biotech company that develops medications that work by modulating the biological activity of the gut microbiome. This company is based on the work of Dr. John Alverdy, MD, a world authority on the molecular basis of post-surgical infections. Its platform technology generated a lead asset (CS-0003) that modulates bacterial virulence and […]

Cytosolix is a platform that produces novel derivatives of known small-molecule oncology drugs. These derivatives selectively target cancer cells by targeting acidity in the tumor microenvironment, significantly improving the efficacy of treatment by reducing dose-limiting toxicities.

D2B3 is developing a proprietary monoclonal antibody, D2B3-01, that temporarily opens the blood-brain barrier (BBB) to allow therapeutic agents (including small molecules, peptides, proteins, and oligonucleotides) to reach the brain, then reseals within hours. The venture tackles a fundamental obstacle in neurology and neuro-oncology: over 98% of drugs cannot cross the BBB, which slows development, […]

Decoy Therapeutics (DecoyTx) is a pharmaceutical company commercializing its IMPACT platform, which designs and develops antiviral products that prevent viral infection. Decoy’s platform is fast (weeks to develop lead candidates), versatile (can use different payloads for different viruses/variants), and cheap (at scale, ~$1 USD/dose). DecoyTx is validating this platform with its first product, DCOY101, an […]

Encapsulate is developing an automated tumor-on-a-chip system that replicates the clinical response of cancer patients by screening patient-derived microtumors against clinical treatment regimens to generate a personalized patient response profile.

Encora is developing a wearable device that uses non-invasive, vibratory stimulation to the wrist for acute hand tremor relief. Over eight million Americans suffer from debilitating hand tremors but are not adequately served by the current treatment options. Current options include pharmaceuticals, which have relatively low efficacy and significant side effects, or brain-stimulation surgery, which […]
Epineuron Technologies is a medical device company that helps surgeons expedite nerve recovery through electro-stimulation after nerve-repair surgeries.

EpiVario Inc. is pioneering epigenetic therapeutic development to redefine treatment landscapes for neuropsychiatric disorders. Spun out of the Epigenetics Institute at the University of Pennsylvania, the company develops innovative therapeutics targeting a newly identified epigenetic process involved in trauma-induced fear and stress responses, and addiction-related drug craving. This discovery provides a unique therapeutic target for […]

Evolution Devices has developed a wearable device called EVOWALK that uses AI-enabled Functional Electrical Stimulation to treat movement disorders. Their beachhead indication is Drop Foot, commonly caused by nerve or muscle injury. Their device acts as a real-time movement analyzer and provides targeted muscle stimulation at the right time to improve mobility, increase walking speed, […]

Exogene is a biotechnology startup accelerating the discovery of T-cell-receptor(TCR)-based cell therapies for otherwise untreatable solid tumors. They are building a machine learning platform to comprehensively screen TCRs from tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) derived from cancer patients to rapidly find new cancer targets and target-specific TCRs for therapeutic application. Using novel wet-lab TCR screening technologies (yeast […]

The FIGUR8 technology platform is a versatile set of sensors designed to shift point-of-care musculoskeletal (MSK) diagnostic feedback from the clinic to the home. The platform is the first and only solution for testing the severity and tracking the recovery of MSK injuries via lightweight, low-profile, on-body sensors. FIGUR8 provides an interface that links clinicians […]
FluidAI (formerly NERv Technology) is a medical device company that manufactures diagnostic systems to detect and monitor complications after general and abdominal surgery.
ForCell can apply compressive forces onto non-adherent cells to permit efficient gene modification of red blood cells.

Forcen is a platform-technology company that has developed a force-sensing film that can be applied to robotic surgical instruments, industrial robots, and aerospace applications to enable them to sense their surroundings with the same precision as a person. The first application of the company’s product, ForceFilm, provides surgeons with real-time force data, resulting in increased […]
Front Line Medical Technologies provides a medical device for a critical emergency procedure that cuts off blood flow below the heart to stem extreme blood loss in patients.
Full Circles Therapeutics is developing a non-viral gene writing platform to commercialize “once-and-done” genomic therapies for oncology and genetic diseases.

Gisens Biotech (Gisens) is a point-of-care diagnostic company that develops and utilizes a reagent-free graphene chip biosensor with a microelectronic reader to detect biomarkers in less than five minutes. Gisens’ graphene biosensor is capable of detecting antigens at 10-fold lower concentration than conventional lateral flow assays with a 99.8% predictive value and 100% sensitivity. It […]

Goodcap is developing psychedelic therapeutics for mood disorders, starting with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Their lead drug candidate combines psilocybin, a 5HT2a receptor agonist, and eugenol, a transient receptor potential (TRP) agonist, to mediate both chronic inflammation and oxidative stress, the root causes of the symptomatology of PTSD. It provides PTSD patients with immediate relief […]

Guardian Bio is a therapeutics platform creating the next generation of cell-based cancer vaccines for late stage, solid tumor cancer patients. The proprietary platform is based on conventional dendritic cells type 1 (cDC1s), recently defined and identified as primary drivers of anti-cancer immunity. Guardian Bio differentiates a patient’s stem cells into a cDC1-based therapy that […]
HDAX Therapeutics is a preclinical stage company developing next-gen (2-site binding) small molecule therapeutics for diseases stemming from microtubule dysfunction.

HeartIO is a cloud software company allowing hospital doctors to non-invasively detect the presence and severity of coronary artery disease at the point of care. The platform uses data from common hospital equipment that monitors heart rhythm (12-lead ECG), and a machine learning algorithm built on a database of ten million patients to accurately predict […]
HHC Medical uses wireless electroporation to deliver genetic therapies safely

Honeycomb Therapeutics is operating at the nexus between cell therapy, synthetic biology and biologics. We aim to revolutionize how biologics are administered. Rather than using cells as the therapeutic, we will engineer a long-lived cell type called B cells to make and deliver the therapeutics within the patient’s own body. Using advanced cell engineering technologies, […]

HOPO Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing best-in-class treatments for heavy metal poisoning. Designed to be both safer and more effective than existing chelation therapies, the orally-available drug candidates are aimed at treating exposure to a wide range of heavy metals. Priority use cases include radioactive threat isotopes from a nuclear disaster or dirty […]

Hyivy Health is a medical device and digital health company developing a device for pelvic floor rehabilitation. Their first product is a vaginal wand that measures the vital signs of the pelvic floor (sensation, healthy tissue, muscle control, lubrication, and incontinence) and delivers therapy to improve the strength and function of the muscles, reduce scar […]

Hylid Diagnostics is a medical device company using novel optical sensors to bring affordable, lab-quality blood testing to the home. Their first target market is the 126 million chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients in Canada, US and Europe. Using a hand-held instrument coupled with single-use cartridges, patients measure their biomarkers from a drop of blood.

IDUN technologies is a platform company building a database of brain activity with their built-in EEG earbud device (think: airpods). IDUN leverages their proprietary sensor material to measure and process brain signals with the same signal quality as the clinical gold-standard gel EEG. Their first customer is sleep intervention companies where user EEG data can […]

Immplacate is a preclinical-stage cell therapy company that is clinically developing educated mesenchymal cells (EMCs) for treatment of unwanted immune responses. Mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) are cells that can differentiate into a variety of other cell types.

Inso Biosciences has developed a device that extracts undamaged, intact DNA from biological samples, a requisite for long-read genome sequencing. The device is based on proprietary microfluidic pillars that take biological samples, break open cells, and harvest DNA in the condition it existed while in a fully functioning cell. Inso Biosciences’ device can be used […]

Integrated Nanotherapeutics Inc. (INT) is a biopharmaceutical company (Vancouver, Canada) that is developing a new class of therapeutics, “antigen-specific immune tolerance” using their proprietary multi-cargo lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) platform to deliver mRNA of one or multiple auto-antigens, along with an immune modulator small molecule to train the immune system not to attack self-antigen and to […]

Inteligex is a regenerative medicine company developing stem cell therapy for spinal cord injuries (SCI). Existing methods to treat SCI such as surgery, limit disease progression but do not allow repair and regeneration of the injured spinal cord. Inteligex has developed two stem cell products, Intellicells and SMaRT cells that are able to repair and […]

InventoRR MD is a medical device company developing AbClo, a device that allows surgeons to efficiently close any large abdominal incision at the end of surgery. AbClo is a dynamic closure system that ensures a rapid and consistent closure on openings that were once extremely difficult and dangerous to close.

IRegained is developing an in-home, clinician-directed digital rehabilitation device that assists stroke and traumatic brain injury (TBI) survivors to regain unassisted use of their upper extremities, with a specific focus on hand usage. The product can be used in a rehab clinic, or a patient’s home via remote guidance from therapists. The device provides gamified […]

Iterate Labs is a biomechanics and IOT workplace safety company developing the first industrial wearable and software platform for preventing repetitive motion injuries in industrial workers. Its first product, the Delta One, collects 3D motion data on the hand and wrist, and integrates with the gloves workers are already wearing; its software platform provides data […]

JelikaLite is developing a neuromodulation wearable for autistic children to improve communication skills and reduce social anxiety. The device uses transcranial photobiomodulation (tPBM). This noninvasive stimulation technique shines near-infrared light on specific head regions to improve brain function by reducing inflammation, increasing blood flow, and improving functional brain connectivity. JelikeLite is building the first FDA-breakthrough […]

Jenthera is a CRISPR Cas9-based gene-editing platform that allows for the development of cell-specific precision gene editing (disruption; insertions; corrections), opening up new possibilities for tackling genetic diseases.

Karla Therapeutics aims to treat mood disorders with antibodies that neutralize a newly discovered circulating protein secreted by T-Cells (Imood). Data in mice from this team demonstrates that increased Imood expression leads to anxiety-like behaviours, and blocking Imood expression regresses anxiety-like behaviours, while patients with psychiatric disorders exhibit increased levels of Imood. Approximately one in […]

Kheiron Medical uses advanced AI techniques to help radiologists more efficiently analyze mammography x-ray images for breast cancer screening. The venture has brought together knowledge from radiology, machine learning, and high-performance computing to design tools that help radiologists save time and diagnose more accurately by acting as an independent second reader.

Kolibri is revolutionizing the way we grow cells at scale using sound. Showing 100x increase in cell density and 50x reduction in production costs, Kolibri patented bioreactors which help our partners in drug development unlock patient access to gene therapies. Being cell-agnostic and scalable, Kolibri’s process has significant potential across a range of high-value cell-based […]

Lantern Laboratory has developed an intraoperative brain monitor that uses proprietary algorithms to analyze EEG signals in real time, optimizing anesthesia care. Anesthesia dosing is currently subjective, and incorrect dosing can lead to serious consequences, such as postoperative delirium, long-term cognitive decline, and increased mortality. Lantern’s brain monitor provides real-time, patient-specific data on cognitive age […]

LEADOPTIK Inc. is a venture-backed startup based in San Jose, California building miniature Lidar systems for surgical devices. Their sub-millimeter imaging platform empowers minimally invasive surgery with 3D navigation capability and pathology grade imaging in real-time. LEADOPTIK’s core technology is based on metasurfaces that allow for optics 100x smaller than the width of a human […]

Liberum Biotech built a benchtop device that combines electronics, microfluidics, and cell-free biology to enable low-cost, programmable, on-demand manufacturing of proteins. This platform can produce small (~1mg) doses of purified proteins ten times faster than conventional methods (hours instead of days). The proteins can be of various sizes, biological activities, and can include certain post-translational […]

Lilium Therapeutics is building precisely targeted, higher capacity, safer, more effective, and more manufacturable gene delivery vehicles (STAR Vectors) to unlock genetic medicines for new patient populations.

Limax Biosciences produces the next generation of stretchable hydrogel-based tissue adhesive materials to revolutionize treatments for injuries inside and outside the body. Existing hemostatic dressings and sealants have weak tissue adhesion that result in leaks, tissue rigidity, and cytotoxicity. Limax’s degradable, hydrogel-based material addresses these limitations through strong and rapid adhesion to wet tissue surfaces […]

LINDA Lifetech is an AI-powered software that scans for indicators of breast cancer using images collected by healthcare professionals. The images are processed by machine learning algorithms and a report about potential abnormalities is generated and used by healthcare professionals to triage patients, and validate their initial diagnoses. The platform helps healthcare professionals optimize their […]

Magellan Biomedical is developing a catheter navigation tool that allows for accurate position control of the tip of a flexible device (e.g., guidewire or catheter) and tracking the position of the device relative to the anatomy, which enables real-time 3D visualization and facilitates precise manipulation and control of the device. The technology has broad applications […]
ManagingLife is a digital health company that has created a virtual pain clinic for people suffering from pain to track their pain levels and for treatment to be viewed by various stakeholders.

Maxonis is developing a peptide-hydrogel therapeutic that promotes nerve tissue regeneration following spinal cord injury (SCI) and peripheral nerve injury (PNI). Current treatment options for nerve repair are limited, invasive, and often yield poor functional recovery, leaving patients with few effective solutions. Maxonis’ off-the-shelf injectable hydrogel delivers the patented laminin-derived peptide LDP-196 to stimulate localized […]

mDETECT is a DNA-methylation-based liquid biopsy company that has developed a highly specific and sensitive blood test for the detection and management of metastatic breast cancer. The test can rapidly and accurately determine the tumor burden in patients to assess therapy response. Blood tests for prostate cancer and uveal melanoma are also part of the […]
Mechano Therapeutics has invented a novel drug delivery platform which uses the forces from the patient’s natural movements as the drug release mechanism.

MeOmics has developed a human neuronal cell screening platform to aid neuropsychiatric drug development. The platform uses stem cells from patient blood samples to create active neuron networks, from which it can detect signals that act as biomarkers for psychiatric disorders. Combined with patient data (clinical and genomic), the platform can predict the likelihood of […]
MetaStem Therapeutics is developing a tumor-specific antibody-drug conjugate for the treatment of cancer based on a novel tumor target called podocalyxin (PODXL).

MindTrace is a medical software company developing personalized 3D brain maps to guide neurosurgeries. One of the challenges for surgeons removing brain tumors is to remove as many tumors as possible without damaging the nearby healthy tissue, which can cause cognitive damage. MindTrace pairs 3D brain maps with machine learning algorithms to simulate surgical resection […]
Modulari-T has developed a new receptor architecture to reprogram multiple immune cell types to treat cancer and other diseases.

Modulo Bio is developing a platform that couples machine learning and cell-based models to reprogram the neuroimmune system and slow or reverse neurological diseases. The platform engineers brain immune cells, called microglia, from human tissues at scale and, using neuroimmune system models, assesses how the microglia behave under different conditions. The platform can be used […]
MyoGene Bio is developing therapies for muscle diseases with a gene editing therapy for DMD.

Mytide Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing an industrialized peptide manufacturing platform with AI capabilities that both designs and produces peptides at a higher quality (more than 90%), speed (100 times faster), and reduced direct cost (3 times lower).

Nanochon is a biotechnology company producing a novel 3D printed material that replaces lost and damaged cartilage and encourages new tissue growth to treat joint-related issues due to injuries and osteoarthritis. This material will increase the accessibility of treating knee damage and improve outcomes by temporarily replacing cartilage while encouraging the regrowth of natural cartilage.

Nanology Labs is developing a nano-theranostic agent with capabilities to simultaneously detect solid tumours and improve radiation therapy. This nanoparticulate system is equipped with smart and tumour-selective reactivity that enables sensitive detection of tumours at early stages using MRI as well as can sensitize the tumour to radiation therapy by generating oxygen in the tumour, […]

NearWave is a hardware company that develops a noninvasive breast cancer chemotherapy monitoring device. The device combines a form of infrared spectroscopy and novel photo sensors to detect cancer markers. This is done by measuring the characteristic absorption and scatter of light from biological molecules which are indicative of cancer. NearWave’s technology can predict cancer […]

Neuradaptive is developing an adaptive neuromodulation device designed to stimulate neural circuits involved in learning and memory, initially targeting stroke and traumatic brain injury (TBI) recovery. Their device integrates precisely timed deep brain stimulation with personalized, AI-enabled behavioral training, offering a more targeted and effective alternative to existing therapies for neurological conditions. This approach not […]

Neuralenz has developed a non-invasive, photonics device that continuously and quantitatively measures cerebral blood flow and intracranial pressure, targeting neurocritical care applications such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, and dementia. Currently, Neurologists rely on continuous data obtained from invasive intracranial sensors to diagnose and manage interventions for neurocritical care patients. Neuralenz can obtain the same […]

NeuraStasis is developing an electrical stimulation device to delay the effects of acute ischemic stroke (AIS). The thesis behind this technology is that noninvasive electrical stimulation can preserve brain viability and help protect patients from a lifetime of disability. NeuraStasis’ initial addressable market focuses on AIS patients at stroke centers between diagnosis and revascularization. NeuraStasis […]

NeuraWorx aims to prevent and slow the progression of neurodegenerative disease such as Alzheimer’s Dementia with their mouthguard device. NeuraWorx’s device uniquely stimulates the cranial nerves to improve the flow of blood and cerebrospinal fluid through the brain – both of which are shown in literature to remove brain toxins. Their device will be safer, […]

NeuroBionics is pioneering a new class of minimally invasive neuromodulation technologies that deliver deep brain and peripheral nerve stimulation without open surgery. Using hair-thin, catheter-delivered bioelectronic fibers that navigate blood vessels smaller than 2mm, the system can precisely target deep neural circuits while reducing procedural risks and recovery times. Backed by over a decade of […]

Nia Therapeutics is developing a brain stimulation device to treat memory loss. Nia is initially targeting patients with traumatic brain injuries and plans to target neurodegenerative diseases both of which cause memory loss that is currently untreatable.
Noa Therapeutics is a preclinical biotech company developing of non-steroidal, multimodal small molecules to address the complexity of inflammatory barrier diseases.

Nomic Bio (formerly nplex biosciences) is a biotechnology company that offers pharma and academia the ability to measure many proteins from blood samples with high sensitivity and cost efficiency. Its platform is immediately deployable in many research facilities as it is compatible with current workflows, read-out instruments, and automation tools.
NuvoBio is developing an artificial intelligence platform to design highly-specific peptide therapeutics without requiring previous knowledge of the protein structure.
Obatala Sciences is a biotechnology toolkit company providing stem cells, hydrogels, and stell cell–based therapies to advance the fields of obesity and diabetes regenerative medicine treatments.
Odin Technologies provides a wearable device that measures patient blood flow, allowing for nurses and physicians to monitor and make treatment decisions.
Oncoelectronics has developed a flexible implantable electrode that treats cancers by zapping them with electricity.

Origami is discovering oral drugs to halt neurodegeneration. Their approach involves eliminating the toxic proteins that are the underlying cause of neurodegeneration using protein degraders to restore normal function. Origami’s discovery platform leverages our proprietary human disease models to select the drugs with the best chance of clinical success.
OrisDX has developed a test that detects oral cancers through saliva using genetic and molecular techniques.
OXcan has developed a liquid biopsy blood test to detect cancers early, starting with lung cancer, by generating unique blood-based biomarkers through the use of advanced proteomics and AI.
Oxford Brain Diagnostics is a medical imaging company that analyzes brain MRIs to measure the progression of brain-related diseases such as Alzheimer’s.

Oxford Immune Algorithmics (OIA) has developed hardware and software, ‘Algocyte,’ that enables clinical blood tests to be done from home. Using a finger prick a patient can load their blood onto a cartridge, insert it into the mobile health reader; the results are then uploaded to the cloud where they are analyzed by OIA’s proprietary […]

Panakeia Technologies is a deep-learning platform that allows pathologists to get comprehensive diagnostic information from biopsy images—i.e., locates cancer tissues, distinguishes between benign and invasive cancers, infers aggressiveness and biomarker profiles.

Panaxium is developing an ultra-precision personalized neurostimulation therapy for stroke patients. The therapy combines AI-enabled MRI imaging analysis with implants to drive bioelectrically-instigated brain rewiring to restore lost functions (motor, speech, cognitive, etc.). Uniquely, the implants are biocompatible and iontronic, using ion-conducting polymers. Panaxium can measure and stimulate the necessary neural targets on a continuous […]

panCELLa is developing therapeutic tools applied to a therapeutic cell line that is modified to provide a high level of safety before and after the cells are introduced to the patient. FailSafe acts as a safety switch: the suicide gene is activated by a pro-drug to shut down only the cells that are deregulating while […]
Pando is a synthetic biology company, leveraging generative AI and high-throughput experiments to discover, optimize, and design high-value biological molecules and systems.

Paradox Immunotherapeutics is a pharmaceutical company developing immunotherapies for diseases caused by misfolding of proteins (defects in protein structure). The company’s lead product (LX-96) is an antibody to treat organ failure caused by Amyloid light-chain (AL) amyloidosis – a disease caused by protein misfolding, where the defective proteins clog organs, particularly the heart and kidneys. […]

PhenoTips is a cloud platform that helps geneticists at hospitals document genetic conditions, family history, and other phenotypic data to analyze risk factors and generate predictive insights into potential genetic causes.

Phosphoenix is developing a neural interface to restore rudimentary sight to blind individuals. The interface uses high-density and ultra-flexible probes to stimulate nerve cells in parts of the brain responsible for vision. By activating specific combinations of electrodes, it generates recognizable shapes and patterns, enabling blind individuals to identify objects and navigate their surroundings. Phosphoenix’s […]

Prima is a pattern recognition software technology that helps guide doctor treatment during a cardiac ablation procedure (focusing on atrial fibrillation) to improve procedure outcomes. Prima’s technology inputs biosignal datasets that currently exist in the procedure, detects clinically important signal patterns, and displays on-screen to the physician suggesting next steps for best outcome.

Psyonic produces bionic prosthetic hands for amputees. The product provides industry-leading reaction times, touch feedback via vibrations, and is robust to impacts. It is covered by Medicare, with little to no out-of-pocket costs to users.

QSM Diagnostics is a hardware company selling a point-of-care solution to detect pathogens early and instantaneously using quorum-sensing molecules. It is starting in the veterinary space to detect ear infections.

Quthero is developing novel treatments for rapid, active, and scarless healing for skin wounds (surgical wounds, burns, chronic ulcers) and internal tissues. The technology enables perfect epithelial restoration, which accelerates time to wound closure, inhibits scar tissue formation, and eliminates complications and risks of impaired and improper healing (including infection, pain, amputation, immobility, reduced life […]
Realyze intelligence is a software company that uses AI to accelerate clinical trial enrollment and collection of real-world data for oncology.

Revalia Bio reimagines how we treat chronic diseases that end in organ failure. Revalia disrupts the current preclinical model for device and drug development by using human organs obtained from deceased donors. Their proprietary data capture, integration and analysis systems allows Revalia to record up to five days of data (e.g., expression, metabolic, and functional) […]

Revolve Surgical is a surgical robotics company with a product that closely resembles a typical surgical instrument that reduces the space, cost, and training required compared to current surgical robots.

Roga has developed a brain stimulation wearable device designed to reduce anxiety-related brain activity and an app that provides anti-anxiety sessions and treatment progress-tracking analytics. The device uses an FDA-approved stimulation method for treating anxiety that they have miniaturized to enable on-the-go, discreet, everyday use. Their initial target is the employee stress market, and they […]

Sachi Bio is an RNA therapeutic platform company with a lead autoimmune (inflammasome inhibitor) program that has shown rapid remission and relief in aggressive Ulcerative Colitis and Multiple Sclerosis models (>90% reduction in inflammation in <1week), with excellent target product (oral, shelf-stable, long half-life) and safety-biodistribution profile. Sachi Bio’s platform performs target identification, and first-in-class […]

SaluTech has developed a conductive biomaterial (CBM) to treat the underlying cause of arrhythmia. This CBM has the ability to reduce/diminish arrhythmia while being nontoxic, biocompatible, and inexpensive to produce.

Sinaptica Therapeutics has developed SinaptiStim™, a personalized rTMS (repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation) neuromodulation system delivering non-invasive, ML-driven neurostimulation to enhance neuroplasticity in key brain networks to slow the progression of Alzheimer's.
